title: Dream from last night
content: Hey all, I wonder if anyone was at the same place as me last night. My dream was mostly at my college dorm world last night, which is like a big college dorm or hotel with many rooms and hallways. I was trying to make it through like a fun house type thing that was apparently part of the college world. I was with 2 friends I don’t really speak to anymore. At the end there was AI performances that kept turning off, kind of like animatronics shutting down. It was like an obstacle course I had to get through. I visited the lake house too, it was for sale. I think I’m buying a property in the dream world? Idk what that means but that’s kind of new to me, as I don’t think I own anything in the mall world. I’m just a visitor. Thoughts? Can anyone relate?
